summary: This document discloses a vacuum tap containing a suction cup and a chamber with central and tangential channels, where the suction cup cavity is connected to the central channel, and the tangential channels are connected to a compressed air source.

rows.label: claim 1[b]
rows.claim_text: a housing which has a grip portion for gripping the grip unit, and an, electrically operated, vacuum generating device
rows.claim_paraphrase: a housing which has a grip portion for gripping the grip unit, and an, electrically operated, vacuum generating device
rows.quote: VACUUM TAP containing a suction cup and a chamber with central and tangential channels, the suction cup cavity being connected to the central channel, and the tangential channels being connected to a compressed air source
rows.note: The reference describes a vacuum grip with a suction cup and channels, which implies a housing, Instead, it uses a compressed air source.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a VACUUM TAP containing a suction cup and a chamber with central and tangential channels, and a compressed air source.

rows.label: claim 9[b]
rows.claim_text: said suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal, which is fastened to the carrier plate and extends around the carrier plate; and
rows.claim_paraphrase: said suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal, which is fastened to the carrier plate and extends around the carrier plate; and
rows.quote: VACUUM TAP containing a suction cup
rows.note: The reference mentions a 'suction cup' which can be considered a suction plate with a seal
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a VACUUM TAP containing a suction cup.

rows.label: claim 11[a]
rows.claim_text: The vacuum handling apparatus according to claim 9, wherein the grip unit has a suction opening, which is fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate in order to generate a vacuum between the suction plate and an object to be lifted
rows.claim_paraphrase: The vacuum handling apparatus according to claim 9, wherein the grip unit has a suction opening, which is fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate …
rows.quote: VACUUM TAP containing a suction cup and a chamber with central and tangential channels, the suction cup cavity being connected to the central channel
rows.note: The quote describes a suction cup cavity connected to a central channel, which functions as a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber (the suction cup cavity) to generate a vacuum.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a suction cup cavity being connected to the central channel.
